gaps.note: The page never defines a convolution over several axes, nor shows how summing over position pairs becomes a sum over residue-tuple pairs, so the reader cannot check that the reindexed sum has that form.

gaps.term: Cited placement of the radix-digit coefficient list
gaps.quote: The radix-digit coefficient list is placed on $s$ distinct prime axes (cited).
gaps.note: This cited claim is the core layout of the map, but the page does not say what the source establishes about the placement or why it applies to this list, so the reader cannot check it from the page.
The page asserts that shifts and address interchanges make the reordering cheap without stating any cost measure or showing why the operations are cheap.
